title: ATG Mandate Spec
description: Input spec for atralith.mandate_builder.build(). Validated before the builder adds id, created_at, and hash. Fields are intentionally generic so concrete profiles (CITYFLIGHT, RCP, etc.) supply their own values.

agent.description: Agent authorized to act under this mandate.

constraints.description: Constraints on the mandate (validity window, limits, required approvals, etc.).

expires_at.description: ISO8601 UTC expiry for the mandate.
